name: Model Village
description: A sunlit 1:12 model village with an empty square at its heart.
lighting: Warm low afternoon sun from one side, long consistent shadows
subject: either
prompt: A sunny model village at one-twelfth scale spreads across a clipped lawn: tiny red-tiled cottages no taller than a knee, a church with a thin spire, trimmed box hedges, a toy railway line curving through and a small cobbled square in the middle. The camera sits right down at grass level at the edge of that square, looking along the little lanes toward the horizon, and life-size blades of lawn grass and a few real daisies in the foreground stand taller than the cottage doors, so the scale reads at once. Warm afternoon sun from one side gives every cottage and hedge a long crisp shadow falling the same way. Everything is in sharp focus, a real model village rather than a blurred miniature effect. The palette is brick red, box green, cream and summer blue, charming and quietly absurd.
